system.description:
Permafrost and ice, with long polar nights. Winter lasts most of the year, and a fire is worth more than a blade. People hold close to their own and hold their tempers in until it counts.

Talent: one Wit die to d6, one Presence die to d6.

  • Cowing Rebuke. You learn the Cowing Rebuke Technique: Sonic, Intimidated.
  • Dark Sight. +2 Training in Acuity.
